name: Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B

position.nope_layers: the 16 global layers (layer_rope_theta 0); RoPE only on the 46 sliding-window layers

moe.router: sigmoid scores with correction bias, top-8, renormalised; reads the full 8192-wide input

stack.note: config layer_types: global at 0-based 1, 5, ... 61; all 62 layers MoE

steps.label: 128 query / 16 KV heads of 64; weightless QK RMSNorm, q times 5.47; local: window 2048 + RoPE / global: full, NoPE; output RMSNorm, then sigmoid gate
learned residual gate: alpha * residual + beta * output
8192 -> 4096, RMSNorm, top-8 of 256 SwiGLU experts, each output normed, -> 8192

specials.name: residual_gate
specials.what: each residual add is a learned per-channel mix: beta = sigmoid(g / 0.3), alpha = sqrt(sigmoid(-g / 0.3) * (1 + beta))
specials.where: after attention and after the MoE

specials.name: latent_moe
specials.what: pre_expert_proj 8192 -> 4096 with norm; post_expert_norm on each expert output; post_expert_proj back to 8192; no shared expert

specials.name: gated_attention
specials.what: attention output RMS-normed, then multiplied by sigmoid(gate_proj(x)) before o_proj

omitted_towers.what: Perception Encoder: 1536 wide, 16 heads, 14x14 patches, learned absolute + 2D RoPE; window attention with every 4th and the last layer full; also reads video
convolutional audio tower, four stages (256, 512, 1024, 2048 wide), causal conv kernel 7

notes: Earlier scoping found the config gated with no mirror. This pass found the public README (model card) and an ungated mirror (unsloth/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B) whose HF API lists the Meta repo as base_model; the transformers muse_spark code gives the block. No field rests on Raschka's YAML alone.

The config and weight index come from an ungated copy whose git blob ids match the files listed by the gated Meta repo's public API, so they are Meta's own files; they agree with every figure on Meta's card.
